negative_control.finding: The shorter scale fails the sufficient 8*x^5 exponential comparison; this does not by itself refute LargeX

proof_assumptions: For x=2^L, log(x+1) <= L+1 and log(2) <= 1
Monotonicity of exp converts the rational-exponent comparisons into sufficient LargeX bounds
Parameter values are chosen freely, not via the original structured Scale object
Source predicates are matched by pinned Git blobs; original unlicensed proof bodies are not redistributed
limitations: The numerical checks are exact, but generic logarithmic lemmas were used as mathematical facts rather than independently formalized in Lean
Only two epsilon values were tested, with single x values each
These checks do not construct the original Scale, D7, FamP, adm5, adm6, adm7, GPsi, or theta/Galois data
The overall claimed RH proof has not been independently reconstructed here
